prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Generate ONE complete landscape 16:9 Chinese scientific journal-club slide concept, 1600x900 design coordinate system.
The attached S04 is the USER-APPROVED style reference. Match its navy Chinese typography, clean white surface, thin blue rounded panel outlines, pale blue header washes, precise blue flow arrows, translucent scientific diagrams and sparing gold accents. Similar information density and legibility. This is a graduate academic meeting, calm, clear, detailed and visually integrated. Create the WHOLE slide as a coherent scientific explanatory image. Do not turn it into a generic bullet-point template. Choose a composition appropriate to this slide's meaning rather than copying S04's two rows blindly.
Use exact supplied Chinese content, correct scientific names and mathematical units. Scientific illustrations are schematic; do not invent measured plots, values, experimental photographs or additional findings. Small bottom source line; page number bottom right, all within safe margins. Make labels readable at the full slide size. The S04 attachment supplies STYLE ONLY; do not import its method labels into unrelated pages.

Exact title: “迁移学习辅助钙钛矿水氧化催化剂发现”.
Opening slide, with the title on two lines at top left, navy type at the SAME restrained scale as the S04 reference. Subtitle “论文精读 · 研究生学术组会 · 15 分钟”.
Bibliography clearly typeset: “Chang Jiang et al. | Nature Communications 15, 6301 (2024)” and “DOI: 10.1038/s41467-024-50605-5”.
A rich, coherent graphical abstract across the lower two thirds: left composition-record matrix and labeled stacks “OER 组成 / 非 OER 组成”; middle transparent encoder into two-dimensional composition embedding; right perovskite crystal and schematic electrochemical flask/electrode. Blue directed connectors labeled “学习组成表征” then “筛选并实验验证”. Small gold feedback loop under the main chain. At bottom three brief study questions integrated below the corresponding visual modules: “少量标签如何利用额外组成信息？” “局部模型如何集成？” “实验是否支持候选与机制？”. No large hero numbers, glowing imagery or promotional slogan. Footer “图形摘要为示意；据 Jiang et al. (2024) 主文”。 Page “01 / 11”.
